description.value:
Duration constant

You cannot be forced into an unwilling bargain, deal, or pact with any creature, including your own patron, ever again.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Cannot be forced into an unwilling bargain/deal/pact, ever, by anyone including your own patron" protects a homebrew narrative concept ("a bargain") with no corresponding real pf2e trait or selector -- there is no bargain/pact trait anywhere in pf2e-source to predicate an immunity or bonus against.
